description: Make visual novels and interactive films as web games.
longDescription: Interactive stories are games told in Scenes joined by the player's choices, such as visual novels and interactive films. This plugin gives a template a new story starts from, with the runtime that plays its Scenes, saves and Variables, and a Skill that adds Scenes from starters (main menu, choice, QTE, hotspot, ending, story map, visual novel) and checks the story. Stories made from it are ordinary web games: they keep playing if you remove the plugin.
template.story.title: Interactive Story
template.story.description: A story that plays from its first Scene, with saves, Variables and the Project Style.
